title: Banking Business Analytics (ClickHouse)
description: Business view straight from the ClickHouse audit table: volume, trend, top customers, amount structure and large transactions. Every panel is a fixed SQL query.

panels.title: Today at a glance — transfers / amount / average / max

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS `笔数`, round(sum(amount), 2) AS `总金额`, round(avg(amount), 2) AS `单笔均值`, round(max(amount), 2) AS `最大单笔` FROM banking_analytics.transaction_audit WHERE created_at >= today()

panels.title: Volume per hour — 笔数 / 金额

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(created_at) AS time, count() AS `笔数`, round(sum(amount), 2) AS `金额` FROM banking_analytics.transaction_audit WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 5 付款账户 — 转出金额

targets.rawSql: SELECT from_account AS `账户`, round(sum(amount), 2) AS `转出金额` FROM banking_analytics.transaction_audit GROUP BY `账户` ORDER BY `转出金额` DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: 金额结构 — 小额多还是大额多

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(amount < 100, 'a. <100', amount < 1000, 'b. 100-1k', amount < 10000, 'c. 1k-10k', 'd. >=10k') AS `金额区间`, round(sum(amount), 2) AS `金额` FROM banking_analytics.transaction_audit GROUP BY `金额区间` ORDER BY `金额区间`

panels.title: 大额交易（≥ 10000）— 风控关注

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS `时间`, from_account AS `付款账户`, to_account AS `收款账户`, amount AS `金额`, client_request_id AS `业务单号` FROM banking_analytics.transaction_audit WHERE amount >= 10000 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Settlement outcome — 成功率 / 成功 / 失败 / 总笔数
panels.description: 数据来自 transaction_outcome（账本终态），不是 transaction_audit（事件接收流水）。两者的行数之差 = 进了 Kafka 但未算出结果的事件量。

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(countIf(status = 'COMPLETED') / count() * 100, 1) AS `成功率%`, countIf(status = 'COMPLETED') AS `成功笔数`, countIf(status != 'COMPLETED') AS `失败笔数`, count() AS `总笔数` FROM banking_analytics.transaction_outcome WHERE settled_at >= today()

panels.title: Failure reasons — 失败原因 TOP（账本终态口径）
panels.description: 审计表没有 status 字段，回答不了这一问题；失败原因只存在于账本终态。

targets.rawSql: SELECT error_message AS `失败原因`, count() AS `笔数` FROM banking_analytics.transaction_outcome WHERE status != 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter(settled_at) GROUP BY `失败原因` ORDER BY `笔数` DESC LIMIT 8
